title: PhoneInput
summary: The country button now shows a visible keyboard focus ring (it had none: the whole field only glowed teal). The validation message reveal is the shared change documented in the TextField report (glide instead of pop, 4px gap instead of 6px, polite live region). Heights, formatting and the digits-only behaviour are unchanged.
why: The country button had outline-none and no replacement, so keyboard users could not tell the button from the input (WCAG 2.4.7 Focus Visible). Untitled UI and React Aria both give the country selector its own ring.
See the TextField report for the message reveal research.

scenarioLabels.country-focus-visible: Country button focused with Tab (new ring)
scenarioLabels.country-click-focus: Country button focused by mouse (no ring)
scenarioLabels.static-country (no button): No country handler: plain area, no ring

motion.after: Glides over 240ms spring (see TextField report); gap 4px so the total is 20px

states: Country button / focus by mouse: no ring (focus-visible only); the field's teal focus glow still shows
figmaSteps: Country selector button (46px tall, the full height of the 48px field minus the border): add a Focus-visible variant with an inner stroke 2px, colour --semantic-primary #343E55, positioned 4px inside the button bounds (inside stroke offset 4px), corner radius of the ring 6px (button radius 10px minus the 4px inset). Keep the field's existing teal focus border and glow (--semantic-border-accent #27ABB8, 0 0 4px rgba(39,171,184,0.4)).
Error variant: change the auto layout gap between the field and the message from 6px to 4px. Message 12px / 16px Inter, --semantic-error-text.
Prototype the message reveal as in the TextField report (Smart Animate 240ms Gentle spring; text opacity 150ms ease out, y -2px to 0).
notes: The ring only appears for keyboard focus (focus-visible); a mouse click that focuses the button shows no ring.

Observed, not changed: PhoneInput recreates its controls when a validation message first appears (different root element), which can drop focus or an uncontrolled value; see the TextField report. The message wrapper is keyed so the reveal still plays.
Not changed as instructed: heights (48px), value formatting, digits-only contract.
